note: Official names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them, via Exophase and PSNProfiles. Every guide below is written for this entry, in the author's own words, from the official description plus the cited sources. GTA VI releases 19 November 2026: where the description is the only source, the guide says so and flags what is unconfirmed. No guide text is copied from another guide.

trophies.guide: The capstone: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work the roadmap in order — story, strangers, activities, collectibles, money, cleanup — and this follows on its own. Early estimates put the full list at roughly 200 hours, so treat it as a long project, not a weekend. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list.

Do it before worrying about anything else; the open world and the side content open up after it. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1 by playing its missions in order. Before the chapter ends, meditate at Lucia's balcony spot at Jason's house — it is reported to disappear once Chapter 1 ends and it may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude, the one possibly missable trophy. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (GTABase and PowerPyx on the meditation).

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the hardest trophy on the list by most early rankings. The 100% checklist is reported to ask for less than full completion in places: 300 stunts, 30 races won, 70 challenges, 8 bank vaults and 15 card sets, against the trophies' lower counts of 250, 20, 50, 5 and 3. So most of it finishes itself while you chase the other trophies; do the story first, then work the checklist's remaining items. One early estimate calls the thresholds lenient, about 60% of true completion. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (PowerPyx and Press-Start on the 100% checklist).

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game count, so you do not need them all. Flying under bridges is reported to be the quickest kind — chain bridge runs in a fast plane over the city and the count climbs fast. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past 250 if you want A Long Road. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (GTABase on the 397 stunts and bridge runs).

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. The description says each type, so sample everything the game offers — a race, a fishing trip, an arcade game, the shooting range, a drone race, meditation, bowling and the rest — one go at each. Do it early: it doubles as a tour of what the other trophies will ask of you. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. This is the one possibly missable trophy: the first meditation — Lucia on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1 — is reported to disappear once that chapter ends, and whether it is required is unconfirmed, so do it before finishing Chapter 1. Sources disagree on the total (18 spots per GTABase, 15 on the 100% checklist), so meditate everywhere you find a spot and keep a manual save at the start of every chapter. trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get to 4 stars with your partner beside you, then break line of sight and leave the red search zone. A train tunnel north of Ambrosia is reported to be a good place to vanish, and bank vault robberies are a reliable way to reach 4 stars. trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob one shop, then the next, then the next, all while the wanted level stays up — do not lose the cops between robberies. Shops in north Vice City sit close together, which keeps the run short; if it does not pop after the third, one guide reports a fourth robbery can trigger it. Vaults come from bank robberies; the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' is reported to open the route in — follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars on the way out and have a fast bike ready for the escape. The 100% checklist asks for 8 vaults, so keep robbing past 5. trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it and get away clean. Pick a quiet stretch of road so the escape is easier than the robbery. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. This means clearing the fog from the whole map. Flying over the dark patches is reported to be the quickest way — take a plane or helicopter and sweep the uncovered areas. Pair it with WAiNK photos and card hunting so the same trips serve three trophies. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (GTABase on clearing the fog).

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs, and you need one illegal operation from each. Work through the gang list methodically and tick them off as you go — the ones you hit for other robberies may already count. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (GTABase on the 9 gangs).

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view and order a cocktail. The exact steps are unconfirmed at launch — the description is the only hint — so try the beachfront bars and let the trophy come to you while you play. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (steps unconfirmed, per PowerPyx).

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car through a showroom window and out the other side. One early guess ties it to crashing out of a showroom — unconfirmed — so treat it as a stunt to try when you pass a showroom rather than a trophy to grind. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (GTABase guess, unconfirmed; PowerPyx marks it not yet known).

trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and play a full game. trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. One guide reports this means maxing out Strength for both characters. Train both Jason and Lucia — gym work, fights and anything else that builds Strength — until both are maxed. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (GTABase on maxing Strength, single source).

trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). One guide links this to the Criminal Profile: 500 actions that change it. The profile tracks what you do, so a long, varied playthrough builds it — it is a count of how you play, not a single choice. Note: one source warns a Criminal Profile entry is permanent, so check the profile before going on a rampage. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (GTABase on the Criminal Profile, single source).

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. A drive-by with a melee weapon is the core of it, and bowling is involved — the exact steps are unconfirmed at launch. trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; launder them through fences. One fence reportedly pays the best rate — find it and route everything through it. The total grows during the 100% robberies, so this mostly completes itself if you keep laundering as you go. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (GTABase on fences).

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Just spend — clothes, weapons, food, anything from any shop counts toward the total. It tracks across all shops, so normal play covers much of it; top up with big purchases late in the run. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list.

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy the 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, around $160,000 in total. The 4 story garages do not count, so do not stop at four — check the app until every purchasable garage is yours. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list (GTABase on the 8 garages and the price).

trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find 10 vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app and register each one. Any 10 vehicles count — use ones you already own or ones you find on the street. Sources: PlayStation trophy list via Exophase and PSNProfiles; EGamers.io trophy list.
